title: Daydrop
summary: Leave, attendance and payroll software built for small and medium-sized businesses.
description: Daydrop replaces scattered paper processes with one clear system for leave, attendance and payroll.

blocks.heading: A clearer way to run everyday office processes

blocks.text: Daydrop brings leave requests, attendance records and payroll distribution into one secure and straightforward application designed for small and medium-sized businesses.
